description: Statistiche incidenti stradali nei Comuni del Consorzio BIM Teramo nel 2023 is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Consorzio BIM Vomano Tordino di Teramo. Statistiche sugli incidenti stradali nei Comuni del Consorzio BIM Teramo con numero di morti, feriti e persone lesionate. Coverage: Italy. The portal files it under the publisher Consorzio BIM Vomano Tordino di Teramo. Its tags are sicurezza-stradale, traffico. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
